title: Structured AI ideation yields physical strategies for epithelial barrier repair
abstract: arXiv:2611.22988v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: AI systems increasingly support literature analysis, candidate evaluation and hypothesis refinement, but enabling researchers to explore research directions beyond established disciplinary approaches remains challenging. We developed Abelio, an AI system designed to generate novel research directions by expanding investigators' avenues of inquiry. Abelio reformulates research objectives, uses these alternative formulations to identify relevant elements outside conventional disciplinary boundaries, and refines the resulting hypotheses. Each stage integrates divergent exploration with convergent selection through a dedicated subsystem. In quantitative evaluations, proposals generated by the Ideation Core (Abelio's hypothesis-generation core) outperformed those of four frontier large language models in scientific soundness and hypothesis diversity, and three of four in distance from existing literature. translated_title: 结构化AI构思为上皮屏障修复提供物理策略
translated_abstract: AI系统日益支持文献分析、候选方案评估和假设细化，但让研究人员能够探索超越既定学科方法的研究方向仍具有挑战性。我们开发了Abelio，一个旨在通过拓展研究人员的探究途径来生成新颖研究方向的AI系统。Abelio会对研究目标进行重新表述，利用这些替代表述来识别传统学科边界之外的相关要素，并对由此产生的假设进行细化。每个阶段都通过专门的子系统将发散性探索与收敛性选择相结合。在定量评估中，由构思核心（Ideation Core，即Abelio的假设生成核心）生成的方案在科学合理性和假设多样性方面优于四个前沿大语言模型，且在与现有文献的距离方面优于其中三个。子系统消融实验表明，每个子（系统均发挥关键作用）……
tldr: 该研究开发了结构化AI构思系统Abelio，通过重新表述研究目标、跨学科检索要素并迭代细化假设，生成了在科学合理性、多样性和新颖性上超越前沿大语言模型的研究方案，并为上皮屏障修复提出了新的物理修复策略。
en_tdlr: This study introduces Abelio, a structured AI ideation system that generates novel research directions by reformulating research objectives, exploring beyond disciplinary boundaries, and refining hypotheses, outperforming frontier large language models in scientific soundness and hypothesis diversity while yielding physical strategies for epithelial barrier repair.
